summary: Tested the feedback, technical support and problem-report emails to the MantMed team on the backend and in both portals. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass. They cover the 422 checks (feedback without rating, support text under 5 characters, invalid area, portal feedback without rating) and 401 when not logged in. A doctor feedback returns {id, email_sent:true}; sending it again with the same client_id returns the same id and sends no second email. A parent support request returns email_sent:true. The backend log shows the email POST to integrations.emergentagent.com returning 202 Accepted. Doctor UI (/app, 1920px): the TopBar feedback-beta-button opens the dialog with all 3 kinds. Stars show only for Feedback. The tech note shows only for Segnala un problema, and the request includes tech info (page, user_agent, screen, language). All 3 validation toasts are correct. With a forced network failure (route abort), feedback-error shows the 'Connessione assente' message with Riprova and the text is kept. After unblocking, Riprova succeeds with the same client_id and shows the thanks screen and success toast. 'Torna alla dashboard' closes the dialog and the form is reset when reopened. A Feedback-kind submit also succeeds. Patient portal (/portale/impostazioni, 390px mobile): portal-feedback-btn opens the dialog; a support submit calls /api/portal/feedback and shows the thanks screen with 'Torna al portale'. 5 real emails were sent in total (2 from pytest, 3 from the UI).

minor.issue: First name and last name are taken by splitting user.name at the first space. For the doctor 'Dott.ssa Tiziana Foti' the email shows Nome='Dott.ssa' and Cognome='Tiziana Foti'. Parent users already have first_name/last_name fields in the DB, but these are ignored, so compound names such as 'Maria Chiara Rossi' are also split wrongly. Use user.first_name/last_name when present and strip title prefixes (Dott., Dott.ssa, Prof., Dr.) before splitting.

issues: The Area chips are doctor-specific: 'Trascrizione Ambientale / Wispr Flow', 'Agenda Multi-Studio', 'Cassa'. The Feedback placeholder mentions 'otoscopia' and the rating is labelled 'Usabilità' from a doctor's point of view. Parents should get their own area list (e.g. Appuntamenti, Referti, Pagamenti/Ricevute, Messaggi, Altro) and placeholders written for them.
At 390px the dialog runs to the screen edges (no side margin), so its rounded corners touch the viewport.

action_items: Fix how first name and last name are worked out in team_email_html: use user.first_name/last_name and strip title prefixes such as Dott./Dott.ssa.
Optional: make the dialog areas and placeholders specific to parents when parent=true; add a side margin to the dialog on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: beta.submit_feedback: if the email fails, the document is kept with email_sent:false and the client retries with the same client_id. This is correct and idempotent.

Duplicate protection is limited to client_id and user_id. A new dialog session (new client_id) can send unlimited emails, and there is no rate limit on /beta/feedback or /portal/feedback. Consider a per-user throttle so the admin inbox and email credits cannot be flooded.

FeedbackDialog: the error state handles network failure and API errors (errMsg) well. When the error is a 503 (email credits used up), the message is shown but Riprova will keep failing. This is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: 5 feedback docs with TEST_ text in db.feedback (2 doctor via pytest/UI feedback, 1 doctor segnalazione, 2 parent supporto).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feedback tests are in tests/test_feedback_email.py; each run sends 2 real emails to mantmed.it's admin inbox (mantmedicine@gmail.com). Doctor login goes through /app (the Gate shows the login form; /login redirects to the landing page). Portal settings page: /portale/impostazioni. settings-feedback-btn is not on the dashboard; it is in the account settings section and was not clicked in this run.
